mods.name: Crystal Tweaks KoHs
mods.description: Optimized End Crystal interactions with visual and sound customization.

releases.notes:
Crystal Tweaks KoHs 2.2.8 stops the break prediction from touching the world.

Earlier versions removed the attacked crystal from the client. That changed what the crosshair was
on and therefore which packet Vanilla sent next, so a placement right after a break could be
discarded while still spending its four-tick cooldown. It was worse on a fast connection, where more
confirmed crystals are on screen for the ray to land on. It also meant a hit the server refused left
an entity the client could no longer see, silently blocking later placements on that spot.

The crystal is now only skipped while drawing. The entity, the crosshair, the interaction ranges,
the cooldowns and the outgoing packet stream are exactly what an unmodified client produces, and a
refused prediction simply becomes visible again.

How long a crystal stays hidden now follows the round trip the mod measures itself, instead of a
fixed window that was too long on a fast connection and expired mid-flight on a slow one.

**Ghost crystals (optional, off by default)**
A stand-in crystal can be drawn while the server's real one is still in flight, so placing does not
depend on your ping. Enable it under Advanced Tweaks. It is purely visual: the stand-in is never
added to the world, so it cannot be looked at, hit or queried, and no packet can refer to it.

**Requirements**
- Minecraft 26.2
- Fabric Loader 0.19.3 or newer
- Java 25
- Fabric API 0.156.0+26.2
- Mod Menu 20.0.1 or newer (optional)

**Multiplayer**
No gameplay packet is fabricated, delayed, reordered or duplicated, and reach, rotation, attack
cooldown and click rate are untouched. See `docs/LEGITIMACY_AUDIT.md`. Server rules differ; check
yours.

mods.name: Crystal Tweaks KoHs
mods.description: Optimized End Crystal interactions with visual and sound customization.

releases.notes:
Crystal Tweaks KoHs 2.2.7 fixes crystals that stayed invisible on the client while the server still tracked them. Until now the local instant break hid a crystal even when the server refused the hit, so the server kept a crystal your client could no longer see and every later placement on that obsidian was silently rejected with nothing shown on screen. The prediction now only runs for a hit the server is expected to accept.

It also fixes clicks after a break landing on the wrong block, or being dropped entirely while still spending the four-tick use cooldown. That is most noticeable when Attack and Use are bound to separate keys or mouse buttons, since both can fire inside the same tick.

Finally, this build declares the Fabric Loader it was actually built against. Every 2.2.6 build except the 26.2 one required Fabric Loader 0.19.3, a version that was never released for its Minecraft version, which stopped the mod from loading.

The mod is now named Crystal Tweaks KoHs in game, matching the Modrinth project.

**Requirements**
- Minecraft 1.21.10
- Fabric Loader 0.18.4 or newer
- Java 21
- Fabric API 0.138.4+1.21.10
- Mod Menu 16.0.1 or newer (optional)

**Multiplayer**
